From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>

Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@helioshealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private hosting — next technical steps & slot pick

Hi Sanjay / Elena —

Thanks again for the 30-minute discovery earlier — good visibility into your high‑throughput inference needs and the compliance constraints around PHI routing. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock in a technical architecture review (VPC / on‑prem integration):

Recap (quick bullets)
- Target: production private deployment in their US datacenter, 3 availability zones, burst to dedicated pool for nightly batch jobs.
- Data: PHI-in-scope, must be kept in Helios network (no egress to public Redwood hosted buckets).
- Throughput: ~300 concurrent sessions, median prompt length ~600 tokens, peak batch jobs overnight.
- SLOs: 95th p50 latency goal 250ms for interactive paths; nightly batch throughput objective 12M tokens/hr.

Qualification open items (we need these answered before the deep technical call):
1) Network contact + VPN method — who manages on Helios side (VPN vs transit, circuit details)?
2) Desired KMS: do you want to use Helios KMS/HSM or Redwood-managed keys?
3) Storage: will model artifacts live on local SAN/NFS or in an internal object store accessible from the VPC?
4) Regulatory: any additional audit retention beyond SOC2 baseline? (e.g., syslog retention, packet capture)

Proposed next step: 60–75 minute architecture review (we'll bring SE + infra lead) to cover network, auth/KMS, deployment topology, and preflight checklist. Please pick whichever slot works best for your team (all times in PDT):
- Option A: Tue Jun 1, 10:00–11:15 PDT (13:00–14:15 EDT)
- Option B: Wed Jun 2, 15:00–16:15 PDT (18:00–19:15 EDT)
- Option C: Thu Jun 3, 08:30–09:45 PDT (11:30–12:45 EDT)

Precall asks (we'll send a formal prep doc but please try to have these people available):
- Network engineer with VPN/firewall rules authority
- Security/compliance owner for KMS discussion
- A product/owner who can describe peak batch windows and retention needs

I've attached a short network prerequisites sheet and our private-deploy readiness checklist to help prepare for the call. If those times don't work, tell me a couple of windows and we'll accommodate.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Dylan.Brooks@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555‑0182

Attachments: helios-network-prereqs.pdf (1 page), redwood-privdeploy-readiness-checklist.xlsx (interactive checklist)

Hi Dylan —

Thanks for the clear recap. Option A (Tue Jun 1, 10:00 PDT) looks good for us — I can make that slot. I'll ask Rajiv (network) and Priya (security) to join; Rajiv prefers to review the VPN approach beforehand so he'll scan the network sheet you attached.

Two quick answers:
- KMS: we'd prefer Helios-managed keys via our on-prem HSM if possible.
- Storage: model artifacts will be on our internal object store (S3-compatible) that your runtime will need read access to via a peered VPC.

I'll flag the calendar once I see the invite.

— Sanjay
